why: What 'old' means and what $D$ is: the matrix the lemma fixes, before any $\tau$ perturbs it. 'Old' is doing the work of a name here and the name is fifteen lines up.

What 'is contained in' is a conclusion of. 'The entire old image' inherits the universal quantifier of the previous sentence — this sentence has none of its own, so read alone it says neither why the containment holds nor what makes it 'entire'. `≤` between submodules is the formalization supplying the quantifier.
What $D_\tau$ is, four sentences back. $\im D_\tau$ is the only term here that mentions the perturbed matrix, and nothing nearby says what it is.
